decisions.quote: Taken together, the findings of the current study support the association of RGS2 with AIP and focus on a possible protective effect of the minor G allele of SNP rs4606.
decisions.reason: The abstract explicitly concludes that the replication study supports the previously reported association of RGS2 (SNP rs4606) with antipsychotic-induced parkinsonism, and nothing in the supplied text frames the replication outcome as mixed.
